Second, we show that using offline RL, the collected data can be translated into policies with high success rates. We then integrate our local policies with traditional motion planning to solve long-horizon assembly tasks. Across four real-world tasks, using only 2-2.5 h of autonomous data collection, we achieve an average success rate of 96% for long-horizon tasks, compared to 55% for a planning-only baseline and 37% for the strongest end-to-end baseline. Our local policies also reduce applied forces by 49%. Notably, performance remains at 90% for scene-level out-of-distribution scenarios, while end-to-end approaches struggle. In total, we run over 1500 real-world evaluation rollouts. Our results pave the way for targeted data collection in contact-rich tasks and for high success rates in precision applications. Videos and qualitative results are available at https://learnsyslab.github.io/data_and_learning_where_it_matters/

AI.title_translation: 在关键处学习：用于局部接触密集型操作的自主数据收集和离线强化学习
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种模块化方法，结合自主数据收集和离线强化学习来解决接触密集型任务，实现了高成功率和良好的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的端到端学习策略在接触密集型任务中表现脆弱，需要大量手动数据且泛化能力差；经典运动规划虽然泛化能力强但缺乏精度和接触感知能力，无法处理紧密公差任务。
AI.method: 1. 引入自主数据收集方案，在任务的接触密集部分局部收集密集数据，消除对远程操作员技能的依赖。2. 利用离线强化学习将收集到的数据转化为高成功率的策略。3. 将局部策略与传统运动规划集成，以解决长周期装配任务。
AI.result: 在四项真实世界任务中，仅用2-2.5小时自主数据收集，长周期任务平均成功率达96%（规划基线为55%，最强端到端基线为37%）。局部策略将施加力减少49%。在场景级分布外（OOD）情景下，性能仍保持90%。
AI.conclusion: 我们的结果为接触密集型任务中的目标数据收集和高精度应用中的高成功率铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 端到端训练的大数据集学习策略在需要高精度的接触密集型任务中往往表现脆弱。此外，它们通常需要大量手动收集的数据，并且仍然难以泛化到训练场景之外。而经典运动规划虽然泛化能力强，但缺乏处理紧密公差任务所需的精度和接触感知能力。为了可靠地解决具有挑战性的接触密集型任务，我们提出利用机器人数据并在关键处进行学习，采用模块化方法。首先，我们引入了一种针对真实世界的自主数据收集方案，该方案在任务的接触密集部分局部收集密集数据，消除了对远程操作员技能的依赖。其次，我们展示了通过使用离线强化学习，收集到的数据可以转化为高成功率的策略。然后，我们将局部策略与传统运动规划集成，以解决长周期装配任务。在四项真实世界任务中，仅使用2-2.5小时的自主数据收集，我们实现了长周期任务平均96%的成功率，而仅规划基线为55%，最强的端到端基线为37%。我们的局部策略还使施加力减少了49%。值得注意的是，在场景级分布外（out-of-distribution）情景下，性能仍保持在90%，而端到端方法则表现挣扎。总计，我们进行了超过1500次真实世界评估。我们的结果为接触密集型任务中的目标数据收集和高精度应用中的高成功率铺平了道路。视频和定性结果可在 https://learnsyslab.github.io/data_and_learning_where_it_matters/ 查看。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种模块化的机器人操作方法，用于解决接触密集型任务。该方法结合了自主数据收集和离线强化学习，以克服现有端到端学习策略的脆弱性和传统运动规划的精度不足。通过在任务关键接触区域局部收集数据，并利用离线RL学习局部策略，然后将其与传统规划集成，该方法在真实世界任务中实现了显著更高的成功率、更低的力消耗，并展现出优异的分布外泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 自主数据收集, 离线强化学习, 接触密集型操作, 机器人学习, 模块化方法
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于其模块化方法，将自主数据收集、离线强化学习与传统运动规划相结合，有效地解决了接触密集型任务中数据收集效率低、策略泛化性差以及精度不足等核心挑战。特别是在仅2-2.5小时的自主数据收集下达到96%的成功率，并显著提升了分布外泛化能力，展现了该方法在实际应用中的巨大潜力。

title: WorldScape Policy 2.0: Empowering Steerable World Action Modeling with Reasoning-Augmented Memory and In-Context Learning
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) offer a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by jointly modeling visual state transitions and robot actions. However, existing WAMs are constrained by limited temporal context, coarse episode-level language supervision, and predominantly text-only conditioning, which hinder task-progress tracking and fine-grained language-video-action grounding while limiting visual-context reasoning and cross-embodiment transfer. In this paper, we introduce WorldScape Policy 2.0, a controllable WAM with reasoning-augmented long short-term memory. Its causal short-term visual memory supplies recent observations as DiT prefill to preserve local interaction dynamics, while its long short-term event memory organizes historical VLM outputs into global-history, local-active, and event-boundary representations for progress-aware retrieval. The retrieved history augments perception and autoregressively generated planning tokens, yielding an implicit subgoal condition for autonomous planning; semantic forcing further transfers event-level instruction semantics into this latent planning pathway. To establish fine-grained multimodal controllability, we construct ManipEvent-5M, an event-grounded embodied pretraining dataset containing nearly 5 million event segments with aligned action trajectories, episode-level task instructions, segment-level subtask captions, goal images, and video demonstrations. These designs provide a unified interface for autonomous planning from high-level instructions and controllable execution from fine-grained text, goal-image, or video-context prompts. Experiments in both simulation and real-world platforms demonstrate superior capabilities in long-horizon autonomous planning, fine-grained instruction following and in-context adaptation.

AI.title_translation: WorldScape策略2.0：通过推理增强的记忆和上下文学习赋能可控世界动作建模
AI.tldr: 提出WorldScape Policy 2.0，利用推理增强的长短期记忆和ManipEvent-5M数据集，显著提升了机器人世界动作模型在长程规划和多模态控制上的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）受到时间上下文有限、粗粒度语言监督以及主要是纯文本条件的限制，阻碍了任务进度跟踪、细粒度语言-视频-动作的基础对齐、视觉上下文推理以及跨具身迁移。
AI.method: 引入了带有推理增强长短期记忆的可控世界动作模型（WAM），包括用于保持局部交互动态的因果短期视觉记忆，以及用于进展感知检索的长短期事件记忆；构建了包含500万个事件片段的 ManipEvent-5M 数据集，并通过语义强迫将指令语义注入潜在于规划路径中。
AI.result: 在模拟和真实世界平台上的实验表明，该方法在长周期自主规划、细粒度指令遵循和上下文自适应方面具有优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: WorldScape Policy 2.0 结合了推理增强的长短期记忆与多模态上下文学习，在长周期自主规划、细粒度指令遵循及上下文适应性方面展现出优异的性能。
AI.translation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉状态转移和机器人动作，为机器人操作提供了一个有前景的范式。然而，现有的WAMs受限于有限的时间上下文、粗粒度的回合级语言监督以及主要为纯文本的条件约束，这阻碍了任务进度跟踪和细粒度的语言-视频-动作接地，同时也限制了视觉上下文推理和跨具身迁移。在本文中，我们推出了WorldScape Policy 2.0，这是一个具有推理增强长短期记忆的可控WAM。其因果短期视觉记忆提供最近的观测作为DiT预填充以保留局部交互动态，而其长短期事件记忆将历史VLM输出组织为全局历史、局部活动和事件边界表示，用于进度感知检索。检索到的历史增强了感知和自回归生成的规划指令，为自主规划产生了隐式子目标条件；语义强制进一步将事件级指令语义转移到这个潜在的规划路径中。为了建立细粒度的多模态可控性，我们构建了ManipEvent-5M，这是一个事件基础的具身预训练数据集，包含近500万个事件片段，具有对齐的动作轨迹、回合级任务指令、片段级子任务标题、目标图像和视频演示。这些设计为来自高级指令的自主规划以及来自细粒度文本、目标图像或视频上下文提示的可控执行提供了一个统一的接口。在模拟和真实世界平台上的实验证明了其在长视距自主规划、细粒度指令遵循和上下文适应方面的卓越能力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 WorldScape Policy 2.0，这是一个通过推理增强的长短期记忆和上下文学习来增强可控世界动作建模的模型。结合新构建的 ManipEvent-5M 数据集，该模型在长周期规划、细粒度多模态指令遵循及现实与模拟任务执行中表现出色。
AI.keywords: 世界动作模型, 机器人操作, 推理增强记忆, 上下文学习, 多模态控制
AI.comments: 本文提出了WorldScape Policy 2.0，通过引入推理增强的长短期记忆机制和大规模高质量的数据集ManipEvent-5M，有效解决了现有世界动作模型（WAMs）在长程时间上下文、细粒度多模态对齐以及跨具身迁移方面的不足，对机器人操作领域具有重要推动作用。

title: $H^2(Ω)$ A Priori Error Bounds for Boundary-Adapted PINNs Solving Elliptic Dirichlet Problems
summary: We study the numerical resolution of uniformly elliptic Dirichlet boundary value problems (BVPs) by minimization of the PDE residual over a hypothesis space of Neural Networks made to satisfy exactly the boundary conditions through multiplication by a user-defined \emph{distance-to-boundary approximation} $ρ$. While an $L^2(\partialΩ)$ boundary penalty cannot generally guarantee $H^2(Ω)$ error control, we show that exact enforcement can, provided $ρ$ is chosen appropriately. More precisely, we identify a sharp sufficient condition on $ρ$ preserving the regularity needed for $H^2(Ω)$ error control, provide practical constructions of such $ρ$ for general smooth domains $Ω$, and refer to the resulting networks as \emph{boundary-adapted}. For boundary-adapted Rectified Quadratic Unit (ReQU) and hyperbolic tangent (tanh) networks, we then derive explicit high-probability $H^2(Ω)$ convergence rates by combining approximation-theoretic and statistical-learning arguments, making explicit the dependence on $ρ$. Numerical experiments support our theoretical results, showing that appropriate choices of $ρ$ improve accuracy and convergence, while poorly chosen distance functions can substantially degrade the solution. Our proof also yields new VC-dimension bounds for hypothesis spaces of higher-order derivatives of ReQU and tanh networks, together with new approximation bounds for shallow ReQU networks in higher-order Sobolev norms, all of which are of important independent interest.

AI.title_translation: 求解椭圆Dirichlet问题的边界自适应PINN的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 先验误差界
AI.tldr: 本文证明了通过精心设计的距离函数精确施加边界条件的PINN可以实现椭圆问题的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制，并推导了显式收敛率。
AI.motivation: 传统的 $L^2(\partial\Omega)$ 边界惩罚通常无法保证 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制，因此需要研究如何通过精确施加边界条件（利用距离函数）来获得可靠的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 先验误差界。
AI.method: 通过引入用户定义的边界距离近似函数 $ρ$ 严格满足边界条件，结合逼近论和统计学习理论，推导了ReQU和tanh网络的显式高概率 $H^2(\Omega)$ 收敛率，并建立了高阶导数网络的VC维界和浅层ReQU网络的高阶Sobolev范数逼近界。
AI.result: 导出了边界自适应ReQU和tanh网络的显式高概率 $H^2(\Omega)$ 收敛率，证明了合适选择 $ρ$ 可以显著改善精度和收敛性，且副产物包括新的VC维界和高阶Sobolev范数逼近界。
AI.conclusion: 通过精心选择距离到边界的近似函数，边界自适应PINN能够有效保证椭圆型Dirichlet问题的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差收敛性，理论分析和数值实验均证实了这一点。
AI.translation: 我们研究了通过在由用户定义的边界距离近似函数 $ρ$ 相乘来精确满足边界条件的神经网络假设空间上最小化PDE残差，从而数值求解一致椭圆Dirichlet边值问题（BVPs）。虽然 $L^2(\partial\Omega)$ 边界惩罚通常无法保证 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制，但我们证明，如果适当选择 $ρ$，精确施加边界条件可以做到这一点。更准确地说，我们确定了保持 $H^2(\Omega)$ 误差控制所需正则性的关于 $ρ$ 的尖锐充分条件，为一般光滑域 $\Omega$ 提供了此类 $ρ$ 的实际构造，并将所得网络称为“边界自适应”网络。对于边界自适应的修正二次单元（ReQU）和双曲正切（tanh）网络，我们结合逼近论和统计学习论，推导出了显式的、明确依赖于 $ρ$ 的高概率 $H^2(\Omega)$ 收敛率。数值实验支持了我们的理论结果，表明适当选择 $ρ$ 可以提高精度和收敛性，而选择不当的距离函数会显著降低解的质量。我们的证明还产生了关于ReQU和tanh网络高阶导数假设空间的新VC维界，以及关于浅层ReQU网络在高阶Sobolev范数下的新逼近界，所有这些都具有重要的独立研究价值。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了通过乘积形式的距离函数精确满足边界条件的PINN求解椭圆Dirichlet边值问题。作者提出了“边界自适应”神经网络的概念，推导了其在 $H^2(\Omega)$ 范数下的先验误差界和高概率收敛率，并通过数值实验验证了理论结果。
AI.keywords: PINNs, Elliptic Dirichlet Problems, $H^2(\Omega)$ Error Bounds, Boundary-Adapted Neural Networks, VC-dimension
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地研究了通过强制满足边界条件（利用边界距离函数）的物理信息神经网络（PINNs）求解椭圆型狄利克雷问题，并首次给出了严格的 $H^2(\Omega)$ 先验误差界和收敛率，具有重要的理论价值和指导意义。

title: Connected (Dense) Partition for Tree-Like Graphs
summary:
We focus on two variants of graph partitioning problems, connected partition and dense partition. Formally, given a graph $G=(V,E)$ and a partition of its vertices $\mathcal P=\{P_1,\ldots, P_k\}$ we say that $\mathcal P$ is a connected partition of $G$ if each $P_i$ induces a connected graph in $G$. Many classical variants of this problem impose additional restrictions both on the number of parts as well as on the size of each part. Moreover, given a partition $\mathcal P=\{P_1,\ldots, P_k\}$ we define its density by $d(\mathcal P):=\sum_{i=1}^k |E(P_i)|/|V(P_i)|$. The problem Maximum Dense Graph Partition asks to construct a partition of maximum density. We study this problem both with and without fixed number of sets $k$. We prove the following results:
  1. A polynomial time algorithm for \textsc{Maximum Dense Graph Partition} of thick forests, a subclass of chordal graphs, generalizing the previously known polynomial time algorithm on block graphs.
  2. A generic dynamic programming algorithm to construct (if possible) a connected partition into $k$ sets of prescribed sizes on graphs with bounded treewidth. This yields algorithms for both variants of Dense Graph Partition and an efficient construction for the Győri-Lovász theorem.
  3. The $\mathsf{NP}$-hardness of Maximum Dense Graph Partition restricted to split graphs, showing that thick trees are a boundary for the polynomial computability of this problem.

AI.title_translation: 树状图的连通（稠密）划分
AI.tldr: 本文研究了树状图的连通和稠密图划分问题，给出了粗森林和有界树宽图的高效算法，并证明了分裂图上的NP困难性。
AI.motivation: 研究图的连通划分和稠密划分两类变体问题，探索在有约束条件（如部件数量和大小固定）及不同图类下的计算复杂性和算法设计。
AI.method: 提出了针对粗森林的最大稠密图划分多项式时间算法，针对有界树宽图的通用动态规划算法以解决指定大小的k连通划分问题，并证明了分裂图上最大稠密图划分的NP困难性。
AI.result: 1. 证明了粗森林的最大稠密图划分可在多项式时间内求解；2. 给出了有界树宽图上构造指定大小k个连通划分的通用动态规划算法；3. 证明了分裂图上的最大稠密图划分是NP困难的，界定了粗树作为多项式可计算性的边界。
AI.conclusion: 本文解决了树状图及其子类在连通与稠密图划分问题上的复杂性分类，给出了多个多项式时间算法和NP困难性证明。
AI.translation:
我们关注图划分问题的两个变体：连通划分和稠密划分。形式上，给定一个图 $G=(V,E)$ 及其顶点的一个划分 $\mathcal P=\{P_1,\ldots, P_k\}$，如果每个 $P_i$ 在 $G$ 中诱导出一个连通图，则称 $\mathcal P$ 是 $G$ 的一个连通划分。该问题的许多经典变体对部件的数量以及每个部件的大小都施加了额外的限制。此外，给定一个划分 $\mathcal P=\{P_1,\ldots, P_k\}$，我们定义其密度为 $d(\mathcal P):=\sum_{i=1}^k |E(P_i)|/|V(P_i)|$。最大稠密图划分问题要求构造一个具有最大密度的划分。我们研究了固定集合数量 $k$ 和不固定集合 $k$ 两种情况下的该问题。我们证明了以下结果：
1. 针对粗森林（弦图的一个子类，推广了先前已知的块图多项式时间算法）的最大稠密图划分的多项式时间算法。
2. 一个通用的动态规划算法，用于在有界树宽图上构造（如果可能的话）具有规定大小的 $k$ 个集合的连通划分。这为稠密图划分的两类变体以及 Győri-Lovász 定理的高效构造提供了算法。
3. 限制在分裂图上的最大稠密图划分具有 $\mathsf{NP}$ 困难性，这表明粗树是该问题多项式可计算性的边界。
AI.summary: 本文研究了树状图的连通与稠密图划分问题。作者针对粗森林提出了最大稠密图划分的多项式时间算法，开发了有界树宽图上构造指定大小k个连通划分的通用动态规划算法，并证明了分裂图上该问题的NP困难性，从而界定了多项式可计算性的边界。
AI.keywords: 图划分, 连通划分, 稠密划分, 树宽, 动态规划
AI.comments: 该论文在树状图的连通和稠密图划分问题上取得了重要进展，不仅给出了多项式时间算法，还确立了多项式可计算性与NP困难性的边界，理论价值显著。

title: IDEAgent: Agentic Quality-Diversity Search for Research Idea Generation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have significantly advanced the automation of scientific discovery. However, existing systems share a core limitation: they optimize ideas independently for either Quality or Diversity. This often results in closely related ideas or large sets of trivial, unsound, or unclear concepts. We instead argue that research ideation should be framed as a conjunction of Quality and Diversity objectives, i.e., a Quality-Diversity (QD) search. Accordingly, we introduce IDEAgent, a multi-agent framework that tracks idea evolution through lineages. We jointly drive Quality using multi-objective feedback for repair and refinement, while Diversity is achieved through lightweight sequential memory and explicit comparison against completed ideas, historical variants, and rejected proposals. To evaluate this joint objective, we develop Yield, a metric that computes the largest mutually diverse set of ideas satisfying predefined quality thresholds. Across 32 topics spanning 8 CS domains, IDEAgent outperforms the best baseline by 3.89x on Yield, while achieving Yield of at least 2 on 8x as many topics. We further analyze quality improvements, showing that repair and refinement improve logical rigor and clarity while preserving non-obviousness. Lastly, we extend IDEAgent to two algorithm discovery tasks for verifiable quality judgment and find that it still consistently outperforms all baselines, and yields the largest set of high-quality and diverse programs that beat a trivial/standard baseline. To encourage future research on QD-search-based ideation, we open-source IDEAgent at https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent.

AI.title_translation: IDEAgent：用于研究构思生成的智能体质量-多样性搜索
AI.tldr: IDEAgent是一个多智能体框架，通过质量-多样性（QD）搜索联合优化科研构想的质量和多样性，显著提升了科学发现的自动化水平。
AI.motivation: 现有大模型在自动化科学发现时，往往独立优化质量或多样性，导致生成的想法要么高度相似，要么包含大量平庸、 unsound 或不清晰的概念。为此，需将研究构思构建为质量与多样性（QD）的联合优化搜索。
AI.method: 引入IDEAgent多智能体框架，通过血统追踪思想演化，利用多目标反馈进行质量修复与精炼，同时通过轻量级序列内存和显式对比实现多样性。
AI.result: 在跨8个计算机科学领域的32个主题中，IDEAgent在Yield指标上比最佳基线高出3.89倍，并在算法发现任务中同样表现优异。
AI.conclusion: IDEAgent通过结合质量和多样性目标的智能体框架，成功生成了高质量且多样化的科研构想和算法，显著优于现有基线。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）显著推进了科学发现的自动化。然而，现有系统共享一个核心局限：它们独立优化质量或多样性中的某一个目标。这通常导致产生高度相关的想法，或者是大量平庸、不健全或不清晰的概念。我们认为，研究构思应该被构建为质量和多样性（QD）目标的结合，即质量-多样性（QD）搜索。因此，我们介绍了IDEAgent，一个通过血统追踪想法演化的多智能体框架。我们利用多目标反馈共同驱动质量进行修复和精炼，同时通过轻量级序列内存以及对已完成想法、历史变体和被拒绝提案的显式对比来获得多样性。为了评估这一联合目标，我们开发了Yield指标，该指标计算满足预定义质量阈值的最大互不相同的想法集合。在跨越8个CS领域的32个主题中，IDEAgent在Yield指标上比最佳基线高出3.89倍，且在8倍多的主题上达到了至少为2的Yield。我们进一步分析了质量改进，表明修复和精炼提高了逻辑严密性和清晰度，同时保留了非显而易见性。最后，我们将IDEAgent扩展到两个用于可验证质量判断的算法发现任务，发现它仍然一致地优于所有基线，并产生了超越微不足道/标准基线的最大高质量和多样化程序集。为了鼓励对基于QD搜索的构思的未来研究，我们将IDEAgent开源于https://github.com/declare-lab/IDEAgent。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了IDEAgent，一个基于质量-多样性（QD）搜索的多智能体框架，用于解决大模型在科研构想生成中无法兼顾质量和多样性的问题。通过结合质量修复与多样性控制，并提出了新的评估指标Yield，IDEAgent在多个科学领域和算法发现任务中显著超越了现有基线。
AI.keywords: Quality-Diversity搜索, 科学发现, 大语言模型, 多智能体框架, 构思生成
AI.comments: 该论文将质量-多样性（QD）搜索理念引入研究构思生成中，填补了现有大模型在独立优化质量或多样性方面的空白，通过多智能体框架和新指标Yield展现了显著的性能提升。

title: Coordinated Networking for On-Device Agent-Augmented Real-Time Communication
summary: AI agents are enabling a new paradigm of agent-augmented real-time communication (RTC), where humans focus on high-level collaboration, while agents autonomously retrieve, analyze, and generate information in real time to support their interactions. These apps enable new experiences across various domains: for example, when corporate employees co-author a legal document, their agents can discuss and draft on their behalf, sparing them the burden of manually reviewing each other's work. As existing cloud-based agents suffer from privacy risks and unscalable server costs, on-device agent-augmented RTC offers a promising alternative. However, this on-device paradigm introduces a new networking challenge: contention between concurrent traffic flows generated by humans (for live video streaming) and agents (for sending context files for analysis). We design HFS, a framework to ensure both high live video quality and low agent response latency in agent-augmented RTC apps. We achieve the goal through an app-guided multi-flow transport approach, where a unified app-layer orchestrator jointly controls the sending rates of live video and agent context flows based on their heterogeneous app requirements. Our prototype built atop WebRTC and llama.cpp demonstrates that HAFS outperforms baselines, achieving 1.5x higher video quality while reducing agent response time by 31%.

AI.title_translation: 面向端侧智能体增强型实时通信的协同网络技术
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HFS的应用层多流传输框架，解决了端侧AI智能体增强型实时通信中的网络流量竞争问题，实现了更高视频质量和更低智能体延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有的云端AI智能体存在隐私风险和服务器成本不可扩展的问题，转向端侧智能体会带来新的网络挑战：人类生成的实时视频流与智能体生成的上下文传输流之间存在并发流量竞争。为了保证高质量的实时视频和低延迟的智能体响应，需要设计一种协调网络机制。
AI.method: 设计了名为HFS的框架，采用应用层引导的多流传输方法，通过统一的应用层编排器根据异构应用需求联合控制实时视频流和智能体上下文流的发送速率。
AI.result: 基于WebRTC和llama.cpp构建的原型系统表明，与基线方法相比，HFS的视频质量提升了1.5倍，同时将智能体响应时间缩短了31%。
AI.conclusion: 通过应用层统一调度和多流传输机制，HFS能够有效解决端侧智能体增强型RTC中的网络资源竞争问题，显著提升视频质量并降低智能体响应延迟。
AI.translation: AI智能体正在开启一种名为智能体增强型实时通信（RTC）的新范式，人类专注于高级协作，而智能体则实时自主检索、分析和生成信息以支持其交互。这些应用在各个领域带来了新体验：例如，当企业员工共同起草法律文件时，他们的智能体可以代表他们进行讨论和起草，从而免去了手动审查彼此工作的负担。由于现有的基于云的智能体存在隐私风险和不可扩展的服务器成本，端侧智能体增强型RTC提供了一个有前景的替代方案。然而，这种端侧范式引入了一项新的网络挑战：由人类（用于实时视频流传输）和智能体（用于发送用于分析的上下文文件）生成的并发流量流之间存在竞争。我们设计了HFS框架，旨在确保智能体增强型RTC应用中既有高的实时视频质量又有低的智能体响应延迟。我们通过应用引导的多流传输方法实现了这一目标，其中统一的应用层编排器根据其异构应用需求联合控制实时视频和智能体上下文流的发送速率。我们在WebRTC和llama.cpp之上构建的原型表明，HFS优于基线，实现了高出1.5倍的视频质量，同时将智能体响应时间缩短了31%。
AI.summary: 本文针对端侧AI智能体增强型实时通信（RTC）中的网络流量竞争问题，提出了一种名为HFS的应用层多流传输协调框架，通过统一编排实时视频与智能体上下文流的发送速率，实现了视频高质量与智能体低延迟的双重目标。
AI.keywords: AI智能体, 实时通信, 多流传输, 边缘计算, WebRTC
AI.comments: 本文针对端侧AI智能体增强型实时通信（RTC）中的网络流量竞争问题，创新性地提出了应用层引导的多流传输框架HFS，兼顾了视频流的高质量与智能体响应的低延迟，具有很高的实用价值和前瞻性。

title: 6G: From Connectivity Infrastructure to Guaranteed Digital Services
comments: Resubmitted to IEEE Access (Manuscript ID: Access-2026-53703; resubmission of Access-2026-37371). 38 pages, 20 figures, 18 tables, 126 references
summary: Sixth-generation (6G) mobile networks offer an opportunity to align network architecture with operator control, verifiable service outcomes, and governed automation. This article develops four complementary contributions. The Control Compact allocates ownership and governance responsibilities through an own-federate-consume taxonomy. The Guarantee Economy proposes six outcome-priced service tiers aligned with IMT-2030 usage scenarios. The Network MCP Platform, the principal contribution, is a conceptual reference architecture that uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect agentic workflows to operational tools and telecom execution interfaces under operator-defined governance. Two real-network examples from Rakuten Mobile illustrate MCP-enabled agentic workflows: radio access network (RAN) second-line (L2) support combines diagnosis, remediation, and outcome verification, while IP Multimedia Subsystem (IMS) availability investigation combines evidence collection, adaptive investigation, and reporting. These examples support operational feasibility; evaluation of the complete platform, and its performance and security properties, remains future work. A separate TM Forum Level 4 assessment corroborates deployed closed-loop autonomy for a scoped RAN energy-optimization scenario. The fourth contribution presents Rakuten Mobile's public standardization position and a phased deployment roadmap. The analysis distinguishes operational records, external assessment evidence, standards-based requirements, and proposed architectural and commercial extensions. It identifies validation requirements for broader deployment and outcome-based service assurance.

AI.title_translation: 6G：从连接基础设施到有保障的数字服务
AI.tldr: 本文提出了6G演进的四个核心贡献，重点介绍了利用模型上下文协议（MCP）连接智能工作流与电信工具的网络MCP平台，并通过乐天移动的实际案例验证了其操作可行性。
AI.motivation: 第六代（6G）移动网络旨在提供将网络架构与运营商控制、可验证的服务成果以及受控自动化相契合的契机，论文正是为了应对这一演进需求而开发四个互补的贡献。
AI.method: 提出了控制契约（own-federate-consume分类法）、担保经济（六个结果定价的服务层）、网络MCP平台（概念参考架构）以及分阶段部署路线图，并结合乐天移动的两个实际网络案例和TM Forum Level 4评估进行说明。
AI.result: 通过乐天移动的无线接入网（RAN）L2支持和IP多媒体子系统（IMS）可用性调查两个实际案例展示了MCP驱动的智能工作流的操作可行性，并通过TM Forum Level 4评估印证了受控RAN节能场景下的闭环自主性。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过概念框架、商业模式、参考架构及实际案例展示了6G向有保障的数字服务演进的可行性与蓝图，但完整平台的性能与安全评估仍留作未来工作。
AI.translation: 第六代（6G）移动网络提供了一个机会，使网络架构与运营商控制、可验证的服务结果以及受控制的自动化保持一致。本文提出了四个互补的贡献。控制契约通过“拥有-联合-消费”分类法分配所有权和治理职责。担保经济提出了六个与IMT-2030使用场景相一致的结果定价服务层。网络MCP平台作为主要贡献，是一个概念参考架构，它利用模型上下文协议（MCP）在运营商定义的治理下，将智能工作流连接到运维工具和电信执行接口。来自乐天移动的两个真实网络示例说明了MCP驱动的智能工作流：无线接入网（RAN）二线（L2）支持结合了诊断、修复和结果验证，而IP多媒体子系统（IMS）可用性调查结合了证据收集、自适应调查和报告。这些示例支持了操作的可行性；对完整平台及其性能和安全属性的评估仍是未来的工作。一个独立的TM Forum 4级评估证实了在有限的RAN节能场景下部署的闭环自主性。第四个贡献展示了乐天移动的公开标准化立场和分阶段部署路线图。该分析区分了运维记录、外部评估证据、基于标准的要求以及提出的架构和商业扩展，并确定了更广泛部署和基于结果的服务保证的验证要求。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了6G从连接基础设施向有保障的数字服务的转变，提出了四个互补的贡献：控制契约、担保经济、网络MCP平台（概念参考架构）以及公开发布的标准化立场和部署路线图，并通过乐天移动的实际案例验证了其操作可行性。
AI.keywords: 6G, 模型上下文协议 (MCP), 担保经济, 闭环自主性, 网络架构
AI.comments: 该论文提出了6G从单纯的连接基础设施向保障性数字服务的演进方向，创新性地引入了控制契约、担保经济和网络MCP平台（基于模型上下文协议），并通过乐天移动的实际案例展示了其可行性，对未来6G网络架构设计具有重要参考价值。

title: SINT-Flow: Schema Integration using Large Language Model Workflows
summary: The goal of schema integration is, given a set of input schemata or tables, to derive a global, unified schema that is able to represent the concepts, attributes, and relationships of all input tables in a coherent fashion. This paper presents SINT-Flow, a schema integration framework composed of five LLM-based operators that can be combined into workflows to perform fully automated, end-to-end schema integration. In contrast to existing approaches, SINT-Flow can process denormalized source tables that contain attributes describing multiple entity types. During the schema integration process, these tables are decomposed into separate entity-specific relations. To evaluate SINT-Flow, we introduce SINT-Bench, a schema integration benchmark comprising 10 schema integration tasks consisting of altogether 93 relational tables, including tables that describe multiple types of entities. We evaluate SINT-Flow using GPT-5.2 as well as the open-weight model Qwen-3.6-27B as alternative backbone models. Using these models, SINT-Flow achieves a Completeness rate of at least 97% in entity type detection, 81% for attribute detection, and an F1-score of 84% for schema mapping. Furthermore, we perform an ablation study to prove the utility of the applied self-consistency strategy as well as the inclusion of a review loop into the Schema Matching Operator.

AI.title_translation: SINT-Flow：基于大语言模型工作流的模式集成
AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型工作流的自动化模式集成框架SINT-Flow，能够处理去规范化表格并生成全局统一模式。
AI.motivation: 传统的模式集成方法难以有效处理包含多个实体类型的去规范化源表，亟需一种能够利用大语言模型的能力实现全自动、端到端模式集成的新框架。
AI.method: 提出SINT-Flow框架，由五个基于大语言模型的算子组成工作流，支持全自动的端到端模式集成，包括将去规范化表格分解为实体特定关系，并引入了自我一致性策略和审查循环。
AI.result: 在SINT-Bench基准测试中，使用GPT-5.2或Qwen-3.6-27B作为骨干模型时，实体类型检测的完整率至少达到97%，属性检测达到81%，模式映射的F1分数达到84%。消融实验证明了自我一致性策略和审查循环的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SINT-Flow通过结合基于大语言模型的操作符与工作流，能够有效、全自动化地解决复杂的模式集成问题，并在实体类型检测、属性检测和模式映射方面取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 模式集成的目标是，给定一组输入模式或表，推导出一个全局的、统一的模式，能够以连贯的方式表示所有输入表的概念、属性和关系。本文提出了SINT-Flow，这是一个由五个基于大语言模型的操作符组成的模式集成框架，可以组合成工作流来执行全自动、端到端的模式集成。与现有方法相比，SINT-Flow可以处理包含描述多种实体类型的属性的去规范化源表。在模式集成过程中，这些表被分解为独立的实体特定关系。为了评估SINT-Flow，我们引入了SINT-Bench，这是一个模式集成基准，包含10个模式集成任务，总共93个关系表，包括描述多种实体类型的表。我们评估了SINT-Flow，使用GPT-5.2以及开源模型Qwen-3.6-27B作为替代骨干模型。使用这些模型，SINT-Flow在实体类型检测上的完整率至少达到97%，属性检测达到81%，模式映射的F1分数为84%。此外，我们进行了消融实验，证明了所应用的自我一致性策略以及在模式匹配操作符中引入审查循环的实用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SINT-Flow，这是一个由五个基于大语言模型算子组成的模式集成工作流框架，能够全自动处理复杂的去规范化表并生成统一的全局模式。同时，作者推出了SINT-Bench基准测试集，实验表明该框架在多项核心指标上表现优异。
AI.keywords: 模式集成, 大语言模型工作流, 去规范化表格, SINT-Bench
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型工作流引入模式集成任务，能够处理复杂的去规范化表格（包含多种实体类型），并开源了相应的基准测试集SINT-Bench，对自动化数据管理具有重要意义。

title: Using Data-Derived Priors to Guide CNN Architecture Design for NIR Chemometrics
comments: We withdraw this manuscript because further analysis does not adequately support the proposed descriptor-based priors for CNN hyperparameter selection. Observed correlations may reflect dataset-size effects and do not sufficiently account for the prediction task. Substantial methodological revision and extra validation are required
summary: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) for near-infrared (NIR) chemometrics are often designed using generic architectural rules, although spectral datasets differ in sampling, smoothness, redundancy, and sample size. We tested whether these properties can provide empirical priors for CNN design. Across 25 NIR regression tasks, we computed descriptors of dataset size, spectral length and spacing, entropy, intrinsic rank, autocorrelation, and wavelet-scale structure. Two interpretable 1D-CNN scaffolds (a minimal single-convolution model and an extended shallow model with optional branching, dilation, etc) were optimized using five-fold cross-validated Bayesian hyperparameter optimization (HPO). Relationships extracted from near-optimal trials were converted into warm-start heuristics and evaluated directly and through leave-one-dataset-out (LODO) validation. The clearest relationships involved convolutional receptive fields. In the minimal CNN, the preferred kernel fraction decreased with spectral entropy and intrinsic rank, increased with the wavelet energy-support fraction, and the learning rate tended to decrease with training-set size. Direct and LODO heuristics were competitive with HPO, with median test-RMSE ratios of 0.953 and 1.017, respectively. The extended CNN showed similar but less transferable structure across branch usage, dilation, dropout, filter counts, and receptive-field choices. Ten stochastic refits showed seed sensitivity comparable to that of HPO-selected configurations. In a separate experiment, joint preprocessing and CNN HPO outperformed standardized-spectra HPO in 19 of 25 tasks, although gains were dataset-dependent. These results show that spectral descriptors can provide practical CNN design priors, guiding shallow NIR models toward plausible hyperparameter regions before target-specific tuning

title: LaP-Forensics: Latent-Pixel Consistency Guided Multimodal Reasoning for Deepfake Detection
summary: Recent generative models can produce images with few obvious visual artifacts, weakening detectors and explanations that rely only on surface appearance. We present LaP-Forensics, a multimodal framework that augments RGB semantics with reconstruction-based forensic evidence. A frozen Stable Diffusion DDIM inversion-reconstruction model provides a fixed reconstruction reference, and its residual map measures local compatibility with that reference. Independent projectors encode the RGB image and residual map before a structured Where-What-Why model predicts a textual analysis and an artifact mask. Supervised fine-tuning is followed by Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), whose reward combines mask overlap with output-structure and evidence-reference terms. These text-side terms encourage the model to refer to the consistency map but do not constitute a verifier of free-form textual truth. A separate image-level head fuses RGB and DDIM-residual class features. Experiments show cross-generator detection on UniversalFakeDetect and competitive artifact localization on the official SynthScars benchmark. Controlled cue-construction, inversion-horizon, component, reward-term, and counterfactual analyses support the utility of the residual stream under the evaluated settings, while free-form textual faithfulness and reliability under post-processing remain open limitations.

title: Foundational Refinement Proofs for EVM Bytecode, at the Price of Tokens
summary: Relating executable code to a high-level model of its behavior has been a central concern of programming-language research for decades. Formally verified compilers, translation validators and certifying compilers address this problem through different trade-offs between proof effort, automation, generality, and the size of the trusted base. Recently, large language models (LLMs) have begun to change the economics of formal verification. Agentic proof development is now capable of producing machine-checked proofs, sometimes unsupervised, at a scale and speed that were previously out of reach. We propose a verification architecture that takes advantage of this shift. An executable obtains a machine-checked proof that it behaves according to a high-level model, independently of the compiler that produced it. The proof is written by an LLM agent. We evaluate the feasibility of this architecture for the Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM). We build EquiVM, a foundational framework in Lean comprising an executable EVM semantics and a formal specification language, Stele, that gives a high-level authoritative model of the bytecode's behavior, but commits to no source language or compilation toolchain. We state what it means for EVM bytecode to refine a Stele spec and we build a proof library to facilitate proof construction. We evaluate the capabilities of frontier LLMs to construct such proofs, as well as the cost of proof production and repair. Our results show that agents prove 35 real production contracts end to end, without modifying their source or bytecode, among them core contracts of Safe, Morpho, Compound and Uniswap protocols, with bytecode of size close to the maximum the EVM allows. Several proofs need only the initial prompt, the rest a handful of human inputs, and existing proofs are repaired in a fraction of the original time when the source or the compiler configuration changes.

title: Registration-Grounded Spectral Fusion for Unregistered WLI/NBI Endoscopic Lesion Segmentation
summary: White-light imaging (WLI) and narrow-band imaging (NBI) provide complementary cues for endoscopic lesion segmentation, yet their sequential acquisition often results in spatially inconsistent observations. The central challenge is not merely to establish cross-modal correspondence, but to determine how complementary information should be incorporated when such correspondence is uncertain. To address this issue, we propose a correspondence-conditioned, modality-asymmetric complex spectral fusion framework for paired-but-unregistered WLI/NBI segmentation. The framework first establishes bidirectional feature correspondence through topology-regularized registration and derives local reliability from post-warping feature discrepancies. Rather than simply reweighting fused features, the estimated reliability directly controls the construction of modality-asymmetric polar representations, where WLI-derived cues primarily parameterize appearance-related moduli and NBI-derived cues parameterize structure-sensitive angular components. The resulting complex representations are further refined through Fourier-domain recalibration with reliability-biased residual reconstruction. Experiments on FAHSYSU and PICCOLO demonstrate competitive improvements over existing segmentation methods. Module ablations, modality-role reversal, and reliability analyses further support the effectiveness of correspondence-conditioned polar representation learning.

title: IndustryForge-27B: A Domain-Enhanced Multimodal Foundation Model for Industrial CAD
summary: Automating industrial CAD design and manufacturing places distinctive demands on multimodal foundation models: the model must see engineering drawings and 3D geometry screenshots, write correct parametric-modelling scripts and Windows COM API code, and cover the full range from single parts to assemblies. General-purpose multimodal models fall short on these tasks, while single-task fine-tuning is too narrow to support the diverse calls that upper-layer agents issue. We build IndustryForge-27B on top of Qwen3.5-VL-27B by curating and integrating six industrial-CAD sub-corpora totalling $\sim$52k multimodal samples---CAD Visual QA (CAD-VQA), parametric CAD code (text2cadquery), assembly-level CAD code (text2cadquery-assembly), and three COM sub-corpora for Inventor / SolidWorks (com_2d / com_3d / com_assembly)---and training with a unified multi-task SFT recipe. Across four CAD-domain benchmarks IndustryForge-27B lifts the base model by $+33.65$~pp on average and outperforms the strong closed-source model GPT-5.4 on all four; across eleven general-capability benchmarks it retains, and slightly improves upon, the base model ($+1.56$~pp mean, no catastrophic forgetting). IndustryForge-27B will serve as the common substrate for downstream industrial-agent projects, providing a unified starting point for a full-stack industrial agent that spans from CAD design to industrial-software operation, from parts to assemblies, and from single-shot generation to closed-loop self-improvement. Huggingface model: https://huggingface.co/Nianchen/IndustryForge-27B

title: TokenSwap: Benchmarking and Reducing the Modality Gap in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) should exhibit cross-modal consistency, generating consistent responses given semantically equivalent inputs across modalities. However, we observe a systematic discrepancy in model predictions under such cross-modal variations. Specifically, we define the modality gap as the difference in model performance under semantically equivalent textual and multimodal inputs. We introduce TokenSwap, a method that constructs such inputs by replacing textual concepts with semantically aligned images, resulting in sequences where visual tokens are interleaved with text tokens. Based on TokenSwap, we transform existing text-based benchmarks (e.g., MMLU) into image-interleaved counterparts, resulting in TokenSwap-Bench. Across 42 MLLMs, we observe a pervasive modality gap, with performance decreasing by 4.2% to 47.4% when moving from text-only to image-interleaved inputs, averaging 19.6% +/- 3.3% across models. Notably, reasoning models exhibit consistently smaller gaps, achieving an average gap of 10.1% compared to 25.5% for non-reasoning models, suggesting greater robustness in multimodal reasoning across equivalent textual and visual representations. In contrast, neither prompting strategies nor scaling training compute alone reliably reduces the modality gap. Finally, we demonstrate that incorporating TokenSwap during training effectively mitigates this gap, improving cross-modal alignment while preserving strong text-only and vision-language model performance. The project page is available at https://dongxzz.github.io/TokenSwap/.

title: Nonlinear Exchange Dynamics for Independent Sets
summary:
In recent years, nonlinear dynamics derived from kinetic theory have gained attention in the context of sampling configurations of spin systems such as the Ising model. We focus on nonlinear dynamics for the hard-core model, a canonical spin system with hard constraints that specifies a distribution over independent sets in a graph, weighted by their sizes. We explore two distinct types of nonlinear dynamics: the mean-field dynamics, which preserves the density (or average size) of independent sets, and the single-site dynamics, which preserves the marginal vector (i.e., the occupancy probabilities of the vertices). These dynamics are natural stochastic processes for sampling from the hard-core model with a specified density or marginal vector, respectively, both of which are canonical instances of maximum entropy distributions that have been studied in various contexts.
  In contrast to linear Markov chains, there is a significant lack of a fundamental theoretical framework for nonlinear dynamics. We develop foundational theoretical tools for analyzing nonlinear dynamics within the context of the hard-core model. We establish almost linear convergence of both the mean-field and single-site dynamics at sufficiently low density through novel coupling arguments. We also establish exponential decay of relative entropy for the mean-field dynamics all the way up to the critical density. Additionally, we design new algorithms for sampling from the hard-core distribution with either a specified density or a specified marginal vector. These algorithms are based on a related linear Markov chain, called the particle-system dynamics and inspired by the so-called Kac's program, that approximates the associated nonlinear dynamics. As we demonstrate in the paper, they are comparable in time complexity, but simpler to implement, than traditional approaches based on learning parameter values.

title: Noise-aware Verification and Synthesis of Quantum Programs
summary: This work provides a comprehensive framework for noise-aware quantum program analysis, ranging from logical foundations to model checking and automated synthesis. While most research on quantum programming considers an idealized, noise-free semantics for quantum programs, we reason about quantum programs that are executed on real, noisy hardware. We use the error models published by quantum-hardware vendors to give a hardware-dependent semantics to quantum programs. We then present a noise-aware quantum Hoare logic with a relatively complete proof system. We finally use state-space exploration techniques for the hardware-aware verification and synthesis of loop-free quantum programs. In this way, we synthesize optimal, hardware-dependent solutions for parity bit-flip, GHZ state preparation, and other problems that commonly occur as subroutines in larger quantum algorithms. We evaluate our method on all 55 hardware specifications provided by the IBM Qiskit toolkit. Finally, we also show that classical probabilistic branching is needed for optimality in quantum programming.

title: Reducing belief in conspiracy theories as they unfold using large language models
summary: The emergence of conspiracy theories in the wake of major events is a significant societal challenge. Here we test whether conversational dialogues with a large language model (LLM) can reduce belief in immediately unfolding conspiracies. In experiments conducted in the days following the July 2024 assassination attempt on Donald Trump and the September 2025 assassination of Charlie Kirk, U.S. adults (Experiment 1: N = 472; Experiment 2: N = 1042) holding conspiratorial views about the crisis event engaged in a multi-turn conversation with an LLM prompted to reduce their conspiracy belief. Compared to control participants who either discussed an irrelevant topic with an LLM or viewed a static fact sheet, participants in the LLM treatment showed significantly reduced conspiracy beliefs in both experiments. We also found some suggestive evidence of downstream effects of the LLM treatment, observing reduced belief in some -- but not all -- analyses of different conspiratorial beliefs one to two months later. These results shed light on the psychology of emerging conspiracies and highlight the potential for scalable, cognitively-focused interventions to counteract misinformation in the immediate aftermath of high-profile societal events.

title: Fine-Grained $\mathsf{AC}^0$ Lower Bounds for $k$-OV, $k$-XOR, and $k$-SUM via Colored Subgraph Isomorphism
comments: Streamlined the main body to focus on core results; simplified symbols and resolved conflicting notations; improved and simplified proof details
summary:
We study the circuit cost of selecting $k$ objects satisfying orthogonality, zero XOR, or modular zero SUM. Our main lower bounds in nonuniform $\mathsf{AC}^0$ use a common framework of depth-zero projections from colored subgraph isomorphism. The projections use dimension, row count, or bit width $O(k\log n)$ and preserve circuit size, depth, and gate orientation. OV inputs satisfy pairwise distinctness within each array. Our direct XOR bounds require odd $k$, while SUM admits both parities. Stronger lower bounds for suitable source patterns transfer through the same framework to all three targets.
  For every fixed depth $d$ and sufficiently large fixed $k$, we prove unconditional lower bounds $n^{Ω(k)}$ for OV and $(n/k)^{Ω(k)}$ for XOR and SUM, with an absolute constant in the exponent independent of $d$ and $k$; only the threshold on $n$ may depend on $(d,k)$. For $k\to\infty$ with $k=n^{o(1)}$, combining our projections with Beame's small-clique lower bound yields $n^{Ω_d(\min\{\sqrt{k},\log n\})}$ at every fixed depth $d$. We strengthen the exponent to $Ω(k)$ at depth two in both orientations and at depth three with a top disjunction. The depth-three result allows unrestricted bottom fan-in and literal polarity; its proof bounds the probability that a planted copy forms a minterm of an arbitrary fixed CNF over a random background.

title: FEAST: Federated Shared-Space Training for Resource-Heterogeneous Clients
comments: The computations in this work were enabled by resources provided by the National Academic Infrastructure for Supercomputing in Sweden (NAISS), funded by the Swedish Research Council
summary: Federated learning (FL) must serve devices with varying computational capabilities. A fixed model cannot suit all devices, while training one model per deployment limit is costly. Federated supernet training instead learns one elastic model with differently sized subnetworks, then deploys a suitable one to each device. When client inference budgets differ, however, parameters exclusive to high-cost subnetworks are reachable by fewer clients. We propose FEAST, a federated shared-space training framework that counters this imbalance by jointly training multiple subnetworks within each client's limit. Budget-tailored sub-supernet routing sends only the relevant supernet portion, and sparse aggregation merges the returned parameter slices. The trained supernet directly serves the subnetworks used during federation and supports post-hoc extraction of additional subnetworks without federated retraining. We further show that independently assigning clients' training-data volumes and inference budgets can distort accuracy--inference-cost comparisons in heterogeneous FL simulations, and introduce a one-parameter $γ$-allocation protocol to control this coupling. In our experimental setup, the SuperFedNAS and DeepFedNAS supernet training procedures remain near chance at 25M and reach at most $17.09\%$ at $596$M inference MACs; FEAST reaches $71.06\%$ at $596$M, $2.4$ points above the strongest model-heterogeneous weight-sharing baseline at its largest tier. Across CIFAR-100, CINIC-10, and TinyImageNet-200, FEAST achieves the highest population-averaged accuracy among the evaluated weight-sharing methods when each client receives its largest affordable subnetwork. Sub-supernet routing reduces aggregate model-parameter traffic by $6.8\times$ relative to full-supernet transmission.

title: Generalized Convexity and Smoothness via Conjugate Duality, with Applications to Deep Network Training
summary: Stochastic gradient descent (SGD) and its variants train deep neural networks (DNNs) effectively in practice, yet classical optimization theory does not fully explain this success: conventional analyses rest on differentiability, convexity, and smoothness, assumptions that DNN objectives routinely violate. We close this gap by generalizing convexity and smoothness, through Legendre functions and convex conjugation, into a unified optimization framework for DNN training. We introduce \(\mathcal{H}(ψ)\)-convexity and \(\mathcal{H}(Ψ)\)-smoothness, a single formalism that encompasses convex and non-convex as well as smooth and non-smooth objectives and reveals a natural duality between generalized convexity and smoothness. Building on these notions, we derive generalized gradient descent (GD) and generalized SGD via convex conjugation. We prove that generalized GD attains an optimal learning rate of exactly \(1\), and we establish rigorous gradient-energy-based convergence rates for both optimizers. We further recast DNN training as a composite optimization problem and show that its convergence hinges on jointly reducing the gradient energy and controlling the extreme eigenvalues of the structure matrix; a model capacity risk quantifies the residual error that no optimizer can remove. Experiments on six datasets (MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, TREC, and SST-2) and on convolutional, residual, and Transformer architectures, with five loss functions, are consistent with the predicted training dynamics.

title: DriveVLA-M0: Failure-Aware Memory Augmentation for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for end-to-end autonomous driving by enabling unified reasoning across perception, language, and planning. However, existing approaches lack mechanisms to exploit past failures or adapt to distribution shifts, causing the model to persistently underperform on similar scenarios where it has previously failed. In this paper, we propose DriveVLA-M0, a retrieval-augmented VLA with failure-aware latent memory. We construct a latent memory pool that stores failure cases along with their structure scene representations and expert trajectory labels, and design a dedicated Retrieve Model that decouples static road structure and dynamic agent interactions to enable structurally grounded retrieval. At inference time, retrieved cases are injected into the model via a lightweight decoupled LoRA-based test-time training (TTT) mechanism, allowing targeted and scenario-specific correction without modifying the backbone. Extensive experiments on NAVSIMv1 and NAVSIMv2 benchmark demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms prior methods, achieving 94.1 PDMS on Navtest and 47.0 EPDMS on Navhard with only 26.44 ms TTT backward latency overhead. Furthermore, we show that DriveVLA-M0 scales effectively with additional memory, enabling training-free performance gains through memory expansion. The code is available at https://github.com/ZebinX/DriveVLA-M0.

title: CFR without Unbiasedness: Debit-Budgeted Public Feedback
summary: At a finite public-chance cut, partial counterfactual regret minimization (CFR) can evaluate successive outcome batches at learner states changed by earlier batches. Balanced coverage then lacks the conditional unbiasedness used by Monte Carlo CFR analyses. We introduce \emph{target debit}, the one-sided cumulative underestimation needed to transfer regret on delivered feedback to the dense target game. Our central theorem bounds weighted exploitability by delivered-row regret, target debit, and a native alternating-update correction. This yields Debit-Budgeted CFR (DB-CFR), which selects a public plan from completed history, executes it once, and settles its debit afterward. Complete coverage has zero debit and supplies exact recovery. With at most $\ell$ unsettled blocks, hidden debit is bounded by the sum of the $\ell$ largest predictable block envelopes; for fixed $\ell$ and polynomial output weights, the resulting $O(T^{-1})$ term preserves the additive-RM/RM+ rate. A finite converse gives equal-metadata plans with charges $0$ and $11/8$, proving that a nontrivial strict-budget decision requires semantic information or bounded post-execution settlement. In two released heads-up no-limit hold'em turn endgames, all 42 registered shallow comparisons favor partial coverage before complete coverage overtakes it between 32 and 64 rounds. In public Leduc, a lagged rule fixed on four development orders beats the best matched-recurrence-work fixed width on all ten unseen orders (median NashConv gain $0.0456$) without future candidate replay.

AI.title_translation: 无需无偏性的CFR：借记预算公共反馈
AI.tldr: 提出DB-CFR算法，通过引入“目标借记”克服了部分CFR缺乏无偏性的难题，并证明了收敛界限与实证优越性。
AI.motivation: 在有限公共机会切分下，部分CFR在经历早期批次改变的学习者状态下评估后续结果批次，导致平衡覆盖缺乏蒙特卡洛CFR分析中所需的条件无偏性。
AI.method: 引入“目标借记”（将已交付反馈上的遗憾转移到密集目标博弈所需的单侧累积低估项），证明了由交付行遗憾、目标借记及原生交替更新校正构成的加权可利用度界限，并据此设计了DB-CFR算法；算法从完成历史中选择公共规划执行一次并在执行后结算借记。
AI.result: 在固定未结算块数$\ell$及多项式输出权重下，保持了$O(T^{-1})$的RM/RM+收敛速率；在单挑无限注德州扑克转牌残局中，前32-64轮内全部42次浅层比较均偏好部分覆盖；在公共Leduc博弈中，滞后规则在所有10个未见阶数上均击败最佳固定宽度方案（NashConv中位数提升0.0456）。
AI.conclusion: DB-CFR在理论上打破了无偏性限制并保持了理想收敛率，在德州扑克残局等任务中显著提升了前期收敛效率与泛化性能。
AI.translation: 在有限公共机会切分处，部分反事实遗憾最小化（CFR）可以在已被早期批次改变的学习者状态下评估连续的结果批次。此时，平衡覆盖缺乏蒙特卡洛CFR分析所采用的条件无偏性。我们引入了“目标借记”（target debit），即把已交付反馈上的遗憾转移到密集目标博弈所需的单侧累积低估。我们的核心定理利用交付行遗憾、目标借记以及原生的交替更新校正，界定了加权可利用度（weighted exploitability）的上界。由此我们提出了借记预算CFR（DB-CFR），该算法从已完成的历史中选择一个公共规划并执行一次，随后结算其借记。完全覆盖具有零借记并提供精确恢复。在至多包含 $\ell$ 个未结算块的情况下，隐藏借记的上界由 $\ell$ 个最大可预测块包络之和决定；对于固定的 $\ell$ 和多项式输出权重，所得的 $O(T^{-1})$ 项保持了可加性RM/RM+的收敛率。一个有限逆命题给出了费用分别为 0 和 11/8 的等元数据规划，证明了非平凡的严格预算决策需要语义信息或有界的执行后结算。在两个公开的单挑无限注德州扑克转牌圈残局中，在完全覆盖于第 32 到 64 轮之间实现反超之前，所有 42 项记录的浅层比较均偏好部分覆盖。在公共Leduc博弈中，在四个开发阶数上固定的滞后规则在所有十个未见阶数上均击败了最佳匹配循环工作固定宽度规则（中位数 NashConv 增益达 0.0456），且无需未来候选重放。
AI.summary: 本文针对部分CFR在批次评估中破坏条件无偏性的问题，提出了无需无偏假设的借记预算CFR（DB-CFR）。通过引入“目标借记”概念并建立可利用度理论上界，该方法在保持收敛率的同时，在德州扑克与Leduc博弈中表现出显著优于完全覆盖或固定宽度方法的早期收敛速度与性能。
AI.keywords: 反事实遗憾最小化 (CFR), 无偏性, 目标借记 (Target Debit), 借记预算CFR (DB-CFR), 不完全信息博弈

title: The Machine's Internal Clock: Do LLMs Share Human Temporal Illusions?
summary: Human perception of time is subjective. Temporal illusions show that the brain relies on context and relational cues when judging duration. Prior studies established these effects with visual and auditory stimuli. We ask whether written narratives alone can cause these illusions, and whether LLMs respond as human participants do. We introduce a benchmark of 6,684 paired scenarios spanning five illusions, each judged from the character's and the reader's perspective. In our human study (60 participants), participants' judgments matched the predicted directions for all five illusions in at least one perspective (7 of 10 conditions). Across 14 LLMs, models reproduce every effect humans show in the same direction, but on average more strongly. Most effects persisted even after cue words were removed and after controlling for 15 lexical and semantic features. These results show that models and humans agree in direction but not in strength, which cautions against treating LLM judgments as substitutes for human responses for subjective temporal reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 机器的内部时钟：大语言模型是否具有人类的时间错觉？
AI.tldr: 研究表明大语言模型能像人类一样在文本叙事中产生时间错觉，且方向一致，但模型的错觉效应强度普遍显著高于人类。
AI.motivation: 探讨仅通过书面叙事是否能够诱发时间错觉，以及LLM是否会表现出与人类相似的主观时间感知偏差。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含6,684个成对场景、涵盖五种时间错觉的评测基准，从角色和读者两个视角进行评估；对60名人类受试者和14个LLM进行了对比测试，并移除了线索词且控制了15个词汇和语义特征。
AI.result: 人类在至少一种视角下（10个条件中的7个）展现出所有五种错觉的预期方向；14个LLM在相同方向上完全复现了人类的效应，但平均强度更强；在去除线索词并控制15项特征后，大多数效应依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 模型与人类在时间错觉的作用方向上高度一致，但在反应强度上存在明显差异，因此在主观时间推理任务中不能直接用LLM替代人类的判断。
AI.translation: 人类对时间的感知是主观的。时间错觉表明，大脑在判断时长时依赖于上下文和关联线索。以往的研究通过视觉和听觉刺激证实了这些效应。我们探讨纯书面叙事是否也能引发这些错觉，以及大语言模型（LLM）是否会产生与人类受试者相似的反应。我们提出了一个由6,684个成对场景组成的基准，涵盖五种错觉，每种错觉均从角色视角和读者视角进行评判。在包含60名受试者的人类实验中，参与者的判断在至少一种视角下（10种条件中的7种）与所有五种错觉的预测方向一致。在14个LLM中，模型在相同方向上复现了人类表现出的所有效应，但平均而言强度更大。即使在移除线索词并控制了15个词汇和语义特征后，大多数效应依然存在。这些结果表明，模型与人类在判断方向上一致但在强度上存在分歧，这提醒人们在主观时间推理方面，切勿将LLM的判断作为人类反应的替代品。
AI.summary: 本研究探讨了书面叙事能否引发时间错觉以及LLM是否具有与人类相似的反应。通过包含6,684个场景的基准测试，研究对比了60名人类和14个LLM的表现，发现LLM在所有五种错觉上均复现了人类的效应方向，但平均强度显著高于人类，表明LLM在主观时间推理方面不能直接替代人类。
AI.keywords: 时间错觉, 大语言模型, 主观时间感知, 文本叙事, 认知基准
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将认知心理学中的“时间错觉”从传统的视听模态拓展至文本叙事领域，并系统探索了LLM是否具备类似人类的主观时间认知偏差。研究设计严谨，控制了多种语言学特征，并明确指出LLM虽能捕捉错觉方向但会“放大”效应强度，为使用LLM替代人类进行认知与心理学研究提供了重要的警示。

title: Scaled boundary cubature scheme in higher dimensions: integration over polytopes and curved regions
summary: We extend the scaled boundary cubature (SBC) scheme from planar regions to higher-dimensional regions described by oriented boundary patches. The resulting parametrization transforms integrals over compact regions in $\mathbb{R}^d$ into sums of integrals over the boundary-patch parameter domains and a radial coordinate. In three dimensions, this yields a direct volume-integration rule for solids bounded by affine faces, triangular or tensor-product surface patches, B-spline patches, NURBS patches, and combinations of curved and affine boundary representations. For affine polytopes, recursive application of the scaled boundary map yields nested tensor-product rules over simplex sectors; in three dimensions, these reduce to tetrahedral-sector rules that apply equally to convex and nonconvex oriented polyhedra. We also develop transformations for weakly singular integrands. Placing the scaling center at a point singularity exposes the radial power cancelled by the Jacobian, while generalized radial scalings and Gauss--Jacobi quadrature handle fractional powers. A transverse scaled-boundary map provides the analogous construction for affine singular sets, with straight-line examples in three dimensions. Numerical examples verify polynomial exactness on affine polyhedra and a four-dimensional tesseract, rapid convergence on curved B-spline and NURBS solids, and the expected convergence improvements for point and line singularities. Near-boundary singularity tests also identify when additional patch subdivision or patch-parameter transformations are required.

AI.title_translation: 高维比例边界求积格式：多胞形与弯曲区域上的积分
AI.tldr: 本文将比例边界求积格式推广至高维，实现了对多胞形、CAD弯曲几何实体及弱奇异被积函数的精确高效数值积分。
AI.motivation: 克服现有方法在处理高维复杂几何（如仿射多胞形、B样条/NURBS曲线区域）以及弱奇异被积函数体积分时的局限，将比例边界求积方案从平面区域推广至高维空间。
AI.method: 通过定向边界块参数化紧致区域，将体积分转化为边界参数域和径向坐标上的积分之和；对仿射多胞形递归应用比例边界映射以生成嵌套张量积规则；针对点奇异性将缩放中心置于奇点并结合广义径向缩放与Gauss--Jacobi求积，针对仿射奇异集采用横向比例边界映射。
AI.result: 数值实验验证了在仿射多面体和4D超立方体上的多项式精确性、在曲面B样条和NURBS实体上的快速收敛性，以及对点/线奇异积分收敛速度的显著改善；同时明确了近边界奇异情况下需采取的细分或参数变换措施。
AI.conclusion: 比例边界求积方案成功推广至高维空间，为具有复杂仿射/曲面边界的紧致区域以及含弱奇异性被积函数的高精度数值积分提供了一种统一且有效的求积框架。
AI.translation: 我们将比例边界求积（SBC）方案从平面区域推广至由定向边界补丁描述的高维区域。所产生的参数化将 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中紧致区域上的积分转化为边界补丁参数域和径向坐标上的积分之和。在三维空间中，这为由仿射面、三角形或张量积曲面补丁、B样条补丁、NURBS补丁以及曲面和仿射边界混合表示所围成的实体提供了直接的体积分规则。对于仿射多胞形，比例边界映射的递归应用可在单纯形扇区上产生嵌套张量积规则；在三维空间中，这些规则简化为同样适用于凸和非凸定向多面体的四面体扇区规则。我们还针对弱奇异被积函数开发了变换方法。将缩放中心置于点奇点处可抵消雅可比行列式消去的径向幂次，而广义径向缩放和Gauss--Jacobi求积则可处理分数幂次。横向比例边界映射为仿射奇异集提供了类似的构造，并在三维中给出了直线示例。数值算例验证了该方法在仿射多面体和四维超立方体上的多项式精确性、在弯曲B样条和NURBS实体上的快速收敛性，以及对点和线奇异性预期的收敛性提升。近边界奇异性测试还指出了何时需要额外的补丁细分或补丁参数变换。
AI.summary: 本文提出了将比例边界求积（SBC）方案推广至高维空间的方法。该方法将积分区域通过定向边界块转化为边界参数域和径向坐标上的积分，适用于多胞形、样条/NURBS曲面实体以及非凸几何体；同时针对点和线弱奇异被积函数设计了特定的坐标映射与求积策略，数值算例验证了其高精度与快速收敛性。
AI.keywords: 比例边界求积, 高维积分, 多胞形, NURBS, 弱奇异积分
AI.comments: 该研究的重要创新在于将二维比例边界求积（SBC）无缝推广至任意高维，不仅统一了对多胞形、CAD几何（B样条、NURBS）以及非凸几何体的高精度体积积分，还系统解决了点奇异和线奇异积分难题。局限性在于处理近边界奇异点时仍依赖于补丁细分或进一步的参数变换。

title: ReRef-3D: A Benchmark for Spatial Referring Expression-Guided 3D Object Placement
comments: 18 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)
summary: We introduce ReRef-3D, a benchmark for language-guided single-object placement in controlled 3D tabletop scenes. It contains 33,826 instructions across 998 CLEVR-derived scenes, spanning 16 placement types and direct, one-hop, and two-hop references. Given that an instruction defines a region of acceptable placements rather than one coordinate, predictions are evaluated by relation satisfaction and physical validity. Each instruction also includes a verified natural rephrasing. We evaluate LLaVA-3D, 3D-LLM, 3D-LLaVA, LL3DA, and PlaceIt3D, with PlaceIt3D evaluated under both point-based and region-based supervision. Region-supervised PlaceIt3D achieves the highest placement accuracy at about 80% and LLaVA-3D reaches about 70%. Performance varies by relation type, but nearest and aligned remain the most difficult. Rephrasing has little effect on performance overall.
comment: 18 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to ACL Rolling Review (ARR)

AI.title_translation: ReRef-3D：空间指称表达引导的三维物体放置基准
AI.tldr: 论文推出了包含 3.3 万余条指令的 ReRef-3D 物体放置基准，通过区域及物理有效性评估模型性能，其中区域监督的 PlaceIt3D 取得约 80% 的最高准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态空间推理研究缺乏用于评估由空间指称表达引导的 3D 单物体放置能力的受控基准，且现实中放置指令对应的是合规区域而非唯一精确坐标。
AI.method: 提出了 ReRef-3D 基准数据集，包含基于 998 个 CLEVR 衍生场景的 33,826 条指令，涵盖 16 种放置类型及直接、单跳和双跳指称，并提供自然语言重述；基于关系满足度和物理有效性进行区域级预测评估；系统性测试了 LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM、3D-LLaVA、LL3DA 及不同监督形式（点/区域）下的 PlaceIt3D。
AI.result: 区域监督的 PlaceIt3D 取得了最高的放置准确率（约 80%），LLaVA-3D 达到约 70%；不同关系类型表现差异明显，其中“最近（nearest）”和“对齐（aligned）”难度最大；自然语言重述对整体性能影响不显著。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，采用区域监督训练的 PlaceIt3D 模型在此类空间指称放置任务中表现最优，同时指明了“最近”和“对齐”等细粒度空间关系是当前 3D 多模态模型的关键瓶颈。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 ReRef-3D，这是一个在受控三维桌面场景中用于语言引导单物体放置的基准。它包含基于 998 个 CLEVR 衍生场景的 33,826 条指令，涵盖 16 种放置类型以及直接、单跳和双跳指称。鉴于一条指令定义的是一个可接受放置的区域而非单一坐标，模型预测结果通过关系满足度和物理有效性进行评估。每条指令还包含经过验证的自然语言重述。我们评估了 LLaVA-3D、3D-LLM、3D-LLaVA、LL3DA 和 PlaceIt3D，其中 PlaceIt3D 分别在基于点和基于区域的监督下进行了评估。基于区域监督的 PlaceIt3D 取得了约 80% 的最高放置准确率，LLaVA-3D 达到了约 70%。性能因关系类型而异，但“最近”和“对齐”仍然是最困难的关系。总体而言，语言重述对性能影响较小。
AI.summary: 本论文构建了名为 ReRef-3D 的新基准，专门用于评估在受控 3D 桌面场景中受语言引导的单物体放置能力。基准提供多跳空间指称与区域级评估指标，实验证明基于区域监督的 PlaceIt3D 能取得高达 80% 的准确率，同时揭示了特定空间关系对现有 3D 大语言模型仍具较高挑战性。
AI.keywords: 3D物体放置, 空间指称表达, 基准测试, 具身智能, 区域监督
AI.comments: 该论文创新地将语言引导的 3D 物体放置任务定义为区域容许度与物理合理性评估，摆脱了传统单一精确坐标匹配的不合理限制，具有重要的实用价值。然而其局限在于场景主要源于合成的 CLEVR 数据集，物体形状和环境纹理相对简单，未来向复杂、真实世界开放场景的迁移泛化仍需进一步探索。

title: Readiness Barrier Functions: Forward-Invariant Control Authority for Overactuated Multirotor Allocation
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: Allocation schemes that greedily maximize a readiness metric over the actuator fiber bundle of an overactuated multirotor produce commands that jump between disconnected optimal strata, demanding actuator rates no motor can deliver; effort-minimizing schemes are continuous but cannot guarantee that wrench-rate authority stays above any certified level. We reconcile the two by treating authority as a forward-invariant quantity: a control barrier function on the log-determinant of the drag-aware actuator-authority co-metric, enforced at torque level by a quadratic program in the allocation null space. A single design inequality renders the certified set compact and strictly interior to the actuator box, with the readiness cost of any rotor deactivation given in closed form as $\ln(n/(n{-}m))$ for symmetric designs. An explicit alignment ratio states when tracking can stay exact, otherwise the wrench error is bounded by $\mathcal{O}(ρ^{-1/2})$, and a robust variant handles motor-parameter uncertainty with a closed-form floor shift independent of the airframe matrix. On a hexarotor and a fully-actuated octorotor the closed-form gap matches simulation to machine precision. Over $300$ randomized missions, greedy maximization violates the certified floor in up to $51\%$ of authority-scarce missions, while the proposed filter never leaves the certified set and, in the hardest moment reversal, commits a $79\times$ smaller wrench error. The robust variant holds the floor on all $150$ perturbed plants. A high-fidelity simulation with measured propeller and motor data shows that the floor holds under unmodeled aerodynamics, electrical limits, and delay, and where it stops applying.
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication

AI.title_translation: 准备就绪度障壁函数：面向过驱动多旋翼分配的前向不变控制权威
AI.tldr: 提出基于控制障壁函数的就绪度分配滤波方法，通过零空间优化在保证指令连续性的同时，为过驱动多旋翼提供前向不变的控制能力底线保证。
AI.motivation: 在过驱动多旋翼控制分配中，贪婪最大化就绪度会导致指令在非连通最优层流间跳跃并产生电机无法执行的速率阶跃，而传统的控制努力最小化方案虽然连续，却无法保证力矩变化率权威维持在认证水平之上。
AI.method: 将控制权威视为前向不变量，基于考虑气动阻力的执行器权威余度量的对数行列式构建控制障壁函数（CBF），并在分配零空间内通过二次规划（QP）在力矩层面上求解执行；同时推导了保证集合紧致且严格位于执行器盒内部的单设计不等式、显式对齐比率以及应对电机参数不确定性的鲁棒闭式变体。
AI.result: 闭式解析间隙在六旋翼和八旋翼仿真中达到机器精度；在300次随机任务中，贪婪方案在多达51%的权威匮乏任务中违反认证底线，而所提滤波器从未越界，且在最严苛的力矩反转中力矩误差降低了79倍；鲁棒变体在150个扰动系统上全数守住底线，高保真仿真进一步验证了其在未建模气动阻力、电气限制和延迟下的有效边界。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功建立了一种基于准备就绪度障壁函数的分配机制，在消除指令突变的同时，为过驱动多旋翼提供了具备前向不变性保证的认证控制能力底线，显著提升了控制分配的可靠性与鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 在过驱动多旋翼的执行器纤维丛上贪婪最大化准备就绪度度量的分配方案，会产生在非连通最优层流间跳跃的指令，要求电机提供无法实现的执行器速率；而努力最小化方案虽然是连续的，却无法保证力矩变化率权威保持在任何经认证的水平之上。本文通过将权威视为前向不变量来调和两者：针对考虑阻力的执行器权威余度量的对数行列式建立控制障壁函数，并在分配零空间中通过力矩层面的二次规划进行强制约束。单一设计不等式使经认证的集合紧致且严格位于执行器盒内部，对于对称构型，任意旋翼失效的准备就绪度代价以闭式形式给出为 ln(n/(n-m))。显式对齐比率给出了何时能保持精确跟踪的条件，否则力矩误差受限于 O(ρ^(-1/2))，且鲁棒变体通过与机架矩阵无关的闭式底线偏移来应对电机参数不确定性。在六旋翼和全驱动八旋翼上，闭式解析间隙与仿真吻合达到机器精度。在超过300次随机任务中，贪婪最大化在多达51%的权威匮乏任务中违反了认证底线，而所提出的滤波器从未离开认证集合，并在最严苛的力矩反转中将力矩误差缩小了79倍。鲁棒变体在全部150个受扰动对象上均保持了底线。包含实测螺旋桨与电机数据的高保真仿真表明，该底线在存在未建模空气动力学、电气限制和延迟的情况下依然有效，并明确了其失效的边界。
AI.summary: 本文针对过驱动多旋翼提出了一种基于控制障壁函数的准备就绪度分配方法，将执行器控制权威形式化为前向不变量。通过在零空间求解二次规划，不仅保证了分配指令的平滑连续，还严格确保了力矩变化率能力始终处于认证安全集内，兼具优异的跟踪精度与参数鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 控制障壁函数, 过驱动多旋翼, 控制分配, 前向不变性, 执行器权威
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将控制障壁函数（CBF）引入过驱动多旋翼的控制分配零空间优化中，巧妙地解决了分配连续性与维持控制能力（权威度）之间的矛盾；理论分析深入，给出了旋翼停机代价和误差界的闭式解，且仿真验证极为充分（涵盖机器精度验证、蒙特卡洛随机任务及高保真非理想模型）。局限在于主要基于理论和仿真验证，尚未开展真实飞行平台的实验测试。

title: DA-WAM: Decision-Aligned Future Latents for Driving World Models
summary: World models for autonomous driving should anticipate the consequences that matter for driving decisions rather than reconstruct every detail of future scenes. However, predictive representations alone are not guaranteed to distinguish candidate actions that lead to different planning outcomes.We propose DA-WAM, a decision-aligned world action model that couples a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) with candidate-level trajectory scoring. During joint training, the JEPA objective grounds future representations in observed scene dynamics, while the planning objectives encourage these representations to capture distinctions relevant to safety and utility. An action-conditioned predictor generates a distinct future latent for each candidate trajectory, and a multi-head trajectory scorer uses the corresponding latent to estimate planning factors and overall utility. In addition, safety-critical post-training with hard negatives further improves discrimination between geometrically similar trajectories with different safety outcomes. DA-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance among learned camera-based planners on NAVSIM-v1, NAVSIM-v2, and Bench2Drive. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of each component in driving decision-making.

AI.title_translation: DA-WAM：用于驾驶世界模型的决策对齐未来潜在表示
AI.tldr: DA-WAM是一种决策对齐的世界动作模型，它将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与候选轨迹评分相结合，以预测与驾驶决策相关的未来，而非重建所有细节，并在多个基准测试中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶的世界模型应该预测对驾驶决策重要的后果，而不是重建未来场景的每一个细节。然而，单独的预测表示无法保证区分导致不同规划结果的候选动作。
AI.method: DA-WAM提出了一种决策对齐的世界动作模型，将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与候选轨迹评分相结合。在联合训练期间，JEPA目标将未来表示与观察到的场景动态相结合，而规划目标则鼓励这些表示捕获与安全性和效用相关的区别。一个动作条件预测器为每个候选轨迹生成一个独特的未来潜在表示，多头轨迹评分器使用相应的潜在表示来估计规划因素和整体效用。此外，通过硬负例进行的安全关键型后训练进一步提高了具有不同安全结果但几何相似轨迹之间的区分度。
AI.result: DA-WAM在NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2和Bench2Drive上，在基于摄像头的学习型规划器中取得了最先进的性能。消融研究证明了每个组件在驾驶决策中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DA-WAM通过将预测表示与驾驶决策对齐，并在安全关键型后训练中利用硬负例，显著提高了自动驾驶世界模型在区分关键轨迹和实现最优规划方面的能力，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 自动驾驶的世界模型应该预测对驾驶决策重要的后果，而不是重建未来场景的每一个细节。然而，单独的预测表示无法保证区分导致不同规划结果的候选动作。我们提出了DA-WAM，一个决策对齐的世界动作模型，它将联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与候选级别轨迹评分相结合。在联合训练期间，JEPA目标将未来表示与观察到的场景动态相结合，而规划目标则鼓励这些表示捕获与安全性和效用相关的区别。一个动作条件预测器为每个候选轨迹生成一个独特的未来潜在表示，多头轨迹评分器使用相应的潜在表示来估计规划因素和整体效用。此外，通过硬负例进行的安全关键型后训练进一步提高了具有不同安全结果但几何相似轨迹之间的区分度。DA-WAM在NAVSIM-v1、NAVSIM-v2和Bench2Drive上，在基于摄像头的学习型规划器中取得了最先进的性能。消融研究证明了每个组件在驾驶决策中的有效性。
AI.summary: DA-WAM提出了一种决策对齐的世界动作模型，旨在解决自动驾驶世界模型在预测对驾驶决策关键的后果而非所有细节时，难以区分不同规划结果的问题。该模型结合了联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）与候选级别轨迹评分，通过联合训练使未来表示与场景动态对齐，并捕获与安全和效用相关的区别。它为每个候选轨迹生成独特的未来潜在表示，并通过多头评分器评估规划因素和效用。此外，安全关键型后训练利用硬负例提高了对几何相似但结果不同轨迹的区分度。DA-WAM在多个自动驾驶基准测试中达到了基于摄像头学习型规划器的最先进性能。
AI.keywords: 世界模型, 自动驾驶, 决策对齐, 潜在表示, 轨迹评分
AI.comments: DA-WAM的创新点在于将世界模型与决策对齐，明确将预测表示的重点从全面的场景重建转移到对驾驶决策至关重要的信息上。通过引入联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）和候选级别的轨迹评分，以及针对安全关键场景的后训练，该模型有效解决了传统世界模型在区分相似但结果不同轨迹方面的局限性，对提升自动驾驶规划的安全性与效率具有重要意义。

title: Truthful Calibration Measures for Sequential Prediction
summary: Calibration requires probabilistic reports to be conditionally unbiased and reliably interpretable as probabilities. A calibration measure assigns numerical error to miscalibrated reports. Haghtalab et al. (2024) proposed an approximately truthful calibration measure for online prediction, leaving open whether exact truthfulness is compatible with completeness and soundness. We resolve this question negatively for sequential binary prediction: exact truthfulness is incompatible with completeness and soundness, even for independent outcomes. We then show that this impossibility is specific to exact truthfulness. On the positive side, we give two general reductions that transform a base calibration measure satisfying a uniform completeness condition into additively and multiplicatively approximately truthful measures, respectively. Applying the multiplicative reduction, for every $0<\varepsilon<1$ we construct a sound and complete calibration measure that is $1+\exp\left(-Ω(T^{1-\varepsilon})\right)$-multiplicatively truthful. This improves the approximate truthfulness guarantee of Haghtalab et al. (2024). We also prove a general transfer theorem showing that the uniform completeness of one calibration measure transfers to another when they are quantitatively related. Using this result, we show that every consistent calibration measure (Blasiok et al., 2023) satisfies uniform completeness and can serve as the base calibration measure to achieve $1 + o(1)$ multiplicative truthfulness.

AI.title_translation: 序列预测中的真实校准度量
AI.tldr: 本文证明了序列预测中精确真实性无法与完备性和可靠性兼得，并提出了通用归约方法构造出近似真实性显著改进的校准度量。
AI.motivation: 解决 Haghtalab 等人（2024）提出的开放问题，即在在线/序列预测中，精确真实性（exact truthfulness）是否能与校准度量的完备性（completeness）和可靠性（soundness）相兼容。
AI.method: 提出了两种通用归约机制，将满足一致完备性条件的基准校准度量分别转化为加法和乘法近似真实的度量；此外证明了一个通用的迁移定理，使一致完备性能够在具有定量关联的不同度量间迁移。
AI.result: (1) 证明了在序列二元预测中，精确真实性与完备性和可靠性不兼容（即不可能定理）；(2) 构造了满足完备性和可靠性的校准度量，其乘法近似真实性达到 $1+\exp(-\Omega(T^{1-\varepsilon}))$，改进了前人结果；(3) 证明了所有一致校准度量均满足一致完备性，均可用于实现 $1+o(1)$ 的乘法真实性。
AI.conclusion: 精确真实性在序列二元预测中与完备性及可靠性无法兼得，但通过所提出的通用归约框架，可以构造出在指数级别逼近精确真实性的近似真实、完备且可靠的校准度量。
AI.translation: 校准要求概率报告具有条件无偏性，并能可靠地解释为概率。校准度量为未校准的预测报告赋予数值误差。Haghtalab 等人（2024）提出了一种用于在线预测的近似真实校准度量，但留下了精确真实性是否与完备性和可靠性兼容这一未决问题。我们在序列二元预测中给出了否定答案：即使对于独立结果，精确真实性也与完备性和可靠性不兼容。随后我们指出，这种不可能结果仅针对于精确真实性。在正面结果方面，我们给出了两种通用归约方法，可将满足一致完备性条件的基准校准度量分别转化为加法和乘法近似真实的度量。利用乘法归约，对于任意 $0<\varepsilon<1$，我们构造了一个可靠且完备的校准度量，其具备 $1+\exp\left(-\Omega(T^{1-\varepsilon})\right)$ 乘法近似真实性，改进了 Haghtalab 等人（2024）的保证。我们还证明了一个通用的迁移定理，表明当两个校准度量在数量上存在关联时，其中一个度量的一致完备性可以迁移到另一个度量上。借助该结果，我们证明了每个一致校准度量（Blasiok et al., 2023）都满足一致完备性，并可用作基准校准度量以实现 $1 + o(1)$ 乘法真实性。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了序列二元预测中校准度量的真实性问题。论文首先证明了精确真实性与完备性、可靠性之间存在不可能性边界；随后提出加法与乘法通用归约框架，成功构造了具备更优近似真实性保证的完备可靠校准度量，并通过迁移定理确立了该框架对所有一致校准度量的普适适用性。
AI.keywords: 校准度量, 序列预测, 真实性, 完备性与可靠性, 通用归约
AI.comments: 本文在理论上解决了序列预测校准度量中精确真实性与可靠性、完备性兼容性的开放问题，给出了明确的不可能性定论。创新之处在于提出了模块化的加法和乘法归约框架及迁移定理，不仅突破了前人的近似真实性边界，还将结论扩展至所有一致校准度量，对在线学习和算法机制设计具有重要理论意义。

title: ECHO: An Auditable Dual-Path Memory System for Long-Horizon Agents
comments: 8 pages. Revised title and dual-path architecture; updated five-system aggregate evaluation and clarified reader configuration, evidence scope, and limitations
summary: Long-horizon agents require more than retrieval over stored conversations: they must preserve source evidence, revise outdated knowledge, and distinguish relevant memories from sufficient support for an answer. We present ECHO (Embodied Context & History Orchestration), an auditable dual-path memory system. A fast path captures immutable events and serves multi-route recall, while asynchronous workers consolidate experience into revisable state and rebuild derived indexes. Source provenance, temporal authority, and answer realization are explicit boundaries. The service supports original-source packets with evidence-use checks and disables model-based reranking by default. For the latest reported accuracy, the authors confirm mixed retrieved inputs comprising original dialogue and memory summaries, answered by Qwen3-8B with NF4 quantization. In the latest author-supplied five-system aggregate evaluation, ECHO reports 56.27% answer accuracy, 98.04% source Hit@10, 93.58% macro source Recall@5, and 13.92% hallucination flags, with 19.54 ms mean retrieval latency. Its reported accuracy exceeds Mem0 by 4.53 percentage points in this snapshot. The results are descriptive aggregates; matched question-level evaluation and generation latency remain to be established. We separate these observations from earlier published experiments and engineering regressions.
comment: 8 pages. Revised title and dual-path architecture; updated five-system aggregate evaluation and clarified reader configuration, evidence scope, and limitations

AI.title_translation: ECHO：面向长跨度智能体的可审计双路径记忆系统
AI.tldr: ECHO 提出了一种结合不可变事件快速召回与异步状态更新的可审计双路径记忆系统，在显著降低幻觉并提高准确率的同时实现了毫秒级检索延迟。
AI.motivation: 长跨度智能体不仅需要检索历史对话，还需保留来源证据、修正过时知识，并严格区分相关记忆与为答案提供充分支持的依据。
AI.method: 提出 ECHO 双路径记忆系统：快速路径记录不可变事件并负责多路径召回；异步工作节点将经验整合为可修正状态并重建派生索引。系统设定了清晰的来源溯源、时间权威和实现边界，支持带证据使用检查的原始数据包，默认禁用模型重排序，采用混合输入并结合 NF4 量化的 Qwen3-8B 进行生成。
AI.result: 在五系统综合评测中，ECHO 达到 56.27% 的回答准确率（比 Mem0 高 4.53 个百分点）、98.04% 的来源 Hit@10、93.58% 的宏观来源 Recall@5、13.92% 的幻觉标记率，且平均检索延迟仅为 19.54 毫秒。
AI.conclusion: ECHO 展示了双路径记忆架构在提升长跨度智能体溯源能力和准确率方面的有效性，但匹配的问题级评估和生成延迟仍有待进一步验证。
AI.translation: 长跨度智能体不仅需要对已存储的对话进行检索：它们还必须保留来源证据、修正过时的知识，并区分相关记忆与为答案提供充分支持的依据。我们提出了 ECHO（具身上下文与历史编排系统），一种可审计的双路径记忆系统。快速路径捕获不可变事件并提供多路径召回，而异步工作节点将经验整合为可修正的状态并重建派生索引。来源溯源、时间权威和答案实现具有明确的界限。该服务支持包含证据使用检查的原始来源数据包，并默认禁用基于模型的重排序。针对最新报告的准确率，作者确认了混合检索输入（包含原始对话与记忆摘要），并由采用 NF4 量化的 Qwen3-8B 进行回答。在作者最新提供的五系统综合评估中，ECHO 报告了 56.27% 的回答准确率、98.04% 的来源 Hit@10、93.58% 的宏观来源 Recall@5，以及 13.92% 的幻觉标记率，平均检索延迟为 19.54 毫秒。在此快照中，其报告的准确率比 Mem0 高出 4.53 个百分点。这些结果是描述性聚合数据；匹配的问题级评估和生成延迟仍有待建立。我们将这些观察结果与早期发表的实验和工程回归区分开来。
AI.summary: 本文提出了面向长跨度智能体的可审计双路径记忆系统 ECHO。该系统通过快速路径捕获不可变事件，并通过异步工作节点更新可修正状态，建立了明确的证据溯源与时间权威边界。实验表明，ECHO 在保持低检索延迟（19.54 ms）的同时，回答准确率优于 Mem0，并具备极高的来源召回率。
AI.keywords: 长跨度智能体, 记忆系统, 双路径架构, 证据溯源, 检索系统
AI.comments: ECHO 的创新之处在于将不可变事件追踪与动态状态修正解耦，构建了清晰的可审计边界和证据检查机制，避免了单纯依赖向量检索带来的过时与幻觉问题。其局限性在于当前报告的指标仅为聚合描述性结果，尚缺乏匹配的问题级深度评测，且端到端生成延迟未作统计。

title: Ethical LLM-Assisted Research: A Framework for Responsible Delegation, Verification, and Epistemic Value
comments: This is a substantially revised version of submit/7664457. I have extensively revised the manuscript to clarify its scholarly contribution, strengthen the formal framework and literature grounding, and remove or reformulate claims that were not sufficiently supported
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are becoming routine instruments of scientific research, assisting with literature synthesis, hypothesis development, coding, and formal reasoning. Their use raises a central epistemic question: when parts of scientific reasoning are delegated to an artificial system, what conditions must remain under human control for the resulting knowledge claims to retain epistemic legitimacy and accountable authorship? This paper develops a normative and conceptual framework for analyzing such delegation. Scientific reasoning is treated as a distributed process in which the origin of a contribution may vary between human and machine, while responsibility for its acceptance into the scientific record remains human. The framework distinguishes content origin $O(g)$, completion of human verification $V(g)$, responsibility assignment $R(g)$, accountable human ownership $M(g)$, and epistemic outcome $E(g)$. These constructs separate the provenance of a claim from the process by which it is checked, the epistemic outcome of that checking, and the human responsibility attached to its disposition. The central proposition is that the ethical boundary of LLM-assisted research is determined primarily by adequate verification and accountable human ownership rather than by the degree of machine involvement itself. On this basis, the paper develops the notion of an \emph{epistemic audit}: a structured record of delegation, verification, provenance, and responsibility intended to make AI-assisted reasoning transparent and reviewable. The resulting framework provides a formal vocabulary for distinguishing responsible cognitive delegation from the transfer or neglect of epistemic responsibility in scientific research.
